messages:
Eli M: quick idea — a compact 'route burn peek' widget for the rollout strip that surfaces a single "effective tokens" number plus a small disclosure of how it's computed. goal: give PMs a fast signal without implying billing accuracy. thoughts?
Jo W: yes. prefer a single number + a tiny 'i' that expands to a 3-line provenance: "data signals, sampling rate, calc version". keep it readable at 1-column.
Hana L: backend reality: we have per-request token_count and kv_hit boolean. we don't currently emit a per-route prefetch-credit. cheap path: emit a 1m rollup with gross_tokens, kv_hit_count, and sample_count. UI can approximate cache_savings = kv_hit_count * model_avg_cached_tokens.
Eli M: that sounds fine for MVP. include an explicit "estimated" marker and a link to docs explaining shared-key double counting and attribution modes.
Jo W: UX ask: show the CI band: "12.5k ± 22% (est v1)". if sample_count < 50 show "insufficient data" instead to avoid noisy numbers.
Hana L: agree. for attribution we can add a client-side toggle: [first-touch | proportional | pool]. keep toggle local so we don't need backend changes for v1. backend will just provide primitives.
Eli M: edge cases: routes that fan-out to many models will need model-level histograms to avoid terrible over/under estimates. we should tag rollups with the set of model_ids seen in the window. small string list is ok.
Hana L: caution: that could bloat metrics if routes touch many models. instead emit a model_count and dominant_model_id. frontend can offer "breakdown by dominant model" option.
Jo W: rollout plan: feature-flagged -> staging dogfood 3 days -> dark-launch 5% org -> reconcile nightly against batch recon. add alert when median_error > 25% for 12h.
Eli M: runbook snippet for SREs: if effective tokens spike but billing flat -> 1) check route rollup sample_count 2) check shared-key warning in the provenance panel 3) run offline recon `/ops/cost/recon?route=...` 4) if frequent, enable higher sampling for the route.
Hana L: I'll add the rollup job emitting gross_tokens, kv_hit_count, sample_count, model_count, dominant_model_id, calc_version. Also compute a quick bootstrap CI in the rollup and emit `ci_pct` tag.
Jo W: I'll mock the widget (compact number + chevron) and the tiny provenance panel copy. keep language non-billing: "estimate for operational visibility".
infra-bot: scheduled canary: branch "eng/route-burn-peek" -> staging at 2024-10-10T14:00:00Z :rocket:
Eli M: perfect. please paste PR links here when ready and we'll close the loop. :thumbsup:
